TotalBody.name: 1-2 Box & Kick
TotalBody.hint: Keep your knees slightly bent and core engaged as you punch. Keep moving to elevate your heart rate.

TotalBody.name: Burpees
TotalBody.hint: Keep your core engaged as you jump your feet back. Focus on supporting much of your bodyweight with your arms and shoulders. Stay composed as you jump up.

TotalBody.name: Drop & Touch
TotalBody.hint: Stay on your toes and keep moving up and down to elevate your heart rate. As always, keep your core engaged.

TotalBody.name: High Knees
TotalBody.hint: Stay on your toes and keep your core engaged. Lift knees as high as you can and swing your arms forcefully.

TotalBody.name: Jumping Jacks
TotalBody.hint: Stay on your toes. Keep your knees slightly bent

TotalBody.name: Mountain Climbers
TotalBody.hint: Keep your back straight and head in a neutral position. focus on supporting much of your body weight with arms and shoulders. Squeeze your core muscles to help maintain your form and technique.

TotalBody.name: Plyo Split Squat
TotalBody.hint: Start slowly and pause between jumps to make sure you're stable. Build up speed as you get more comfortable with the technique.

TotalBody.name: Side-To-Side Hop
TotalBody.hint: Stay on your toes as you hop from side to side. Keep your core engaged at all times.

TotalBody.name: Skater
TotalBody.hint: Keep your core engaged and keep moving to elevate your heart rate. Don't hop to high and focus on moving side to side like a speed skater.

TotalBody.name: Squat Thrusts
TotalBody.hint: Keep your back straight and head and neck in a neutral position. Focus on supporting much of your body weight. Squeeze your core muscles to help maintain your form and technique.

TotalBody.name: Jump Rope Skip
TotalBody.hint: Stay on your toes and keep your core engaged. Keep your shoulders relaxed and don't forget to breathe.

TotalBody.name: March In Place
TotalBody.hint: Stay on your toes and keep your core engaged. Lift your knees as high as you can and lift your arms.

TotalBody.name: Side-To-Side Shuffle
TotalBody.hint: Stay on your toes as you quicksteps. Keep your core engaged. Swing your arms as if you are running.

TotalBody.name: Squat & Box
TotalBody.hint: Use a wider stance than usual for a wider squat. Keep your core engaged as you punch. Punch rapidly to elevate your heart rate.

TotalBody.name: Stand & Box
TotalBody.hint: Keep your knees slightly bent and core engaged as you punch. Punch rapidly to elevate your heart rate.

LowerBody.name: Chair Split Squat
LowerBody.hint: Start slowly and make sure you are stable. Keep your front knee behind your toes. Bend your back knee as you squat down.

LowerBody.name: Long Jumps
LowerBody.hint: Squat down quickly, then throw your arms upward and forward to help you jump. Remember to push up through your toes.

LowerBody.name: Lunge & Rotation
LowerBody.hint: Lunge slowly art first and make sure you are stable. Keep your front knee behind your toes. Make sure to lunge down, not forward and keep an upright posture. Rotate slowly and carefully.

LowerBody.name: One-Leg Deadlift
LowerBody.hint: Focus on keeping you legs almost straight and focus on bending at the hips, not the knees.

LowerBody.name: One-Leg Power Squat
LowerBody.hint: Focus on moving quickly and jumping high. Swing your arms to help you jump higher.

LowerBody.name: One-Leg Squat
LowerBody.hint: Squat slowly at first and make sure you're stable. Don't squat too deep until you feel able to safely go lower.

LowerBody.name: One-Leg Squat Hops
LowerBody.hint: Maintain the partial squat position while hopping and stay on your toes. Keep your core engaged and maintain your balance.

LowerBody.name: One-Leg Squat Touch
LowerBody.hint: Keep your front knee behind your toes. Use your back leg to counterbalance yourself.

LowerBody.name: One-Leg Wall Sit
LowerBody.hint: Make sure your knees are directly above your ankles. Keep your back flat and against the wall. Don't forget to breathe.

LowerBody.name: Power Squat
LowerBody.hint: Squat down quickly then throw your arms up to help you jump. Push through your toes, then land on your toes before squatting again.

LowerBody.name: Reverse Lunge & Knee Lift
LowerBody.hint: Lunge slowly at first and make sure you are stable. Keep your core engaged as you lift your knee. Focus on your core and technique to help maintain your balance.

LowerBody.name: Side Lunge
LowerBody.hint: Keep your knees behind your toes. Don't lunge too deep. Use your arms to help balance.

LowerBody.name: Chair-Assist Split Squat
LowerBody.hint: Start slowly and make sure you are stable. Keep your front knee behind your toes and bend your back knee as you squat down.

LowerBody.name: Chair-Assist Squat
LowerBody.hint: Keep your knees behind your toes and push through your heels. Use your arms to counter-balance you.

UpperBody.name: Bird Dog Push-Up
UpperBody.hint: Focus on form and technique, not speed. Move slowly and maintain balance and control as you push up.

UpperBody.name: Chair-decline push-up
UpperBody.hint: Squeeze your core muscles to help keep your body straight and don't forget to breathe out as you push up.

UpperBody.name: Chair Pike push-up
UpperBody.hint: Maintain the pike position to keep your legs straight. Focus on using your shoulder muscles and breathe out as you push up.

UpperBody.name: Diamond push-up
UpperBody.hint: Focus on your triceps as you push up and keep your body straight from head to heel. Breathe out as you push up.

UpperBody.name: Downward Dog grasshopper
UpperBody.hint: Squeeze your core muscles to help you bring your knee forward. Don't forget to breathe.

UpperBody.name: Grasshopper Push-Up
UpperBody.hint: Keep your hips up and body straight from head to heel. Squeeze your core muscles to help you bring your knee forward. Breathe out as you push up.

UpperBody.name: Hindu Push-Up
UpperBody.hint: Use a smooth, curving motion as your head dives down and forward past your hands and backwards again. Breathe out as you move back to your starting position.

UpperBody.name: One-Leg Push-Up
UpperBody.hint: Keep your hips up and body straight from head to heel. Squeeze your core muscles to help you hold your leg off the floor. Breathe out as you push up.

UpperBody.name: One-Leg Triceps Dip
UpperBody.hint: Focus on bending the elbows and lowering yourself directly down to the floor. Avoid getting too deep until you get pain in the shoulders.

UpperBody.name: Power Push-Up
UpperBody.hint: Keep your hips up and body straight from head to heel. Push up and try to lift your hands slightly off the floor. Breathe out as you push up.

UpperBody.name: Push-Up and Rotation
UpperBody.hint: Keep your hips up and body straight from head to heel. Rotate slowly at first and make sure you're stable.

UpperBody.name: Spider-Man Push-Up
UpperBody.hint: Keep your hips up and body straight from head to heel. Squeeze your core muscles to help you bring your knee forward. Breathe out as you push up.

UpperBody.name: Chair-Assist Push-Up
UpperBody.hint: Keep your hips up and body straight from head to heel. Breathe out as you push up.

Core.name: Advanced Bird Dog
Core.hint: Move slowly at first as you alternate arms and legs and keep your core stable.

Core.name: Bicycle Crunch
Core.hint: Use a peddling motion with your legs. Keep your core engaged at all times. Don't pull at the back of your head.

Core.name: Full Side Plank
Core.hint: Move slowly and progressively into position. Start with extended arms first, raise your leg last.

Core.name: One-Leg Bridge
Core.hint: Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings as well as your core muscles. Keep your chin off your chest. Don't forget to breathe.

Core.name: Plank
Core.hint: Keep your hips up and body straight from head to heel. Don't forget to breathe.

Core.name: Reverse Crunch & Hug
Core.hint: Keep your core engaged and your head up. Breathe out as you hug your knees to your chest.

Core.name: Reverse Plank
Core.hint: Keep your core engaged and hips up. Make sure your head and neck stay in a neutral position. Don't forget to breathe.

Core.name: Scissor Kicks
Core.hint: Keep your core engaged and don't forget to alternate legs.

Core.name: Side Plank Crunch
Core.hint: Focus on form and technique, not speed. Stabilize your side plank before you crunch.

Core.name: V Sit Twist
Core.hint: Keep your core engaged and your head up. Extend your arms to increase the difficulty.

Core.name: Windscreen Wipers
Core.hint: Keep your core engaged at all times and breathe out as you raise your legs back to center.

Core.name: Abdominal Crunch
Core.hint: Look upwards and keep your chin off your chest. Keep your head and neck in a neutral position.

Core.name: Kneeling Plank
Core.hint: Keep your hips up and body straight from head to knees. Don't forget to breathe.
